text:
alex: Hey @priya @david — Acme is starting a 2-week POC next Mon. Need temporary infra changes: +40% burst headroom on their dedicated pool during demo hours (9:00–17:00 PST weekdays), a FIFO/priority queue for sales demo traffic, scoped API keys for the demo team, and an option for VPC/private endpoint if feasible. Also need a quick overage pricing estimate and a hard billing cap. Any blockers? :rocket:
priya: Which pool ID and what's the expected peak? Also clarify whether you want reserved commit or purely ephemeral burst.
david: We can support a time-bounded burst window and priority tagging. Need pool id, expected qps/tokens, and whether KMS is required for logs. Finance signoff needed for billing cap > $2k.
alex: Pool: dp-acme-55 (baseline 20 GPUs). Expect ~8–12k tokens/s peak across ~4 concurrent high-latency sessions, seq len ~512. No reserve commit — ephemeral only for 2 weeks. KMS for logs + audit is required. Retention request: 90d. Also customer prefers VPC peering but will accept private endpoint if peering timeline is too long.
priya: Ok. VPC peering takes ~48h for ops+network approval; private endpoint is faster (same-day if we spin it up in their region). For autoscale policy we can set a burst_window and hard cap. We need the exact timezone windows for cron.
david: For priority routing we tag requests with header `x-customer-demo: acme` and route to a high-priority queue. That prevents demo traffic from competing with production. We'll need sales to ensure demo clients set the header.
kim: I can drop a small wrapper lib that sets the header and rotates demo API keys. Will also provide a load script so we can smoke-test the queue behavior before go-live.
alex: Perfect. Can you share the autoscale snippet and the pricing delta for +40% burst? Customer wants a simple ballpark to approve.
david: Pricing ballpark: burst usage billed at on-demand rate * 1.25 multiplier. Rough estimate for 2 weeks at expected peak ~ $4,200 additional. I'll confirm exact calc after we get usage profile. Also we can set a billing cap flag that blocks further burst beyond X and notifies finance.
priya: Autoscale snippet (config to apply):
```yaml
pool_id: dp-acme-55
baseline_gpus: 20
burst:
  enabled: true
  percent: 40
  window: "09:00-17:00" # PST, weekdays only
  hard_cap_gpus: 30
priority_routing:
  header: "x-customer-demo"
  value: "acme"
  queue: high-priority
kms: true
retention_days: 90
```
david: I opened ticket INC-2026-77 to track network/peering, key provisioning, and billing cap. ops-bot should post updates.
ops-bot: Ticket INC-2026-77 created and assigned to @priya and @david. Estimated ETA: peering 48h, private endpoint same-day, billing cap requires finance approval.
kim: I'll schedule a 30min smoke test Wed 10:00 PST and send the load script + runbook. Please confirm someone from infra will be on the call. :thumbsup:
david: I can join Wed. Priya will handle the endpoint. Need sales to confirm the hard billing cap number so finance can pre-approve alerts.
alex: Propose hard cap $5,000 for the two weeks and enable billing alerts at $3,000. Customer ok with that.
priya: Noted. I'll apply the autoscale config and queue rules today once you confirm the cap in the ticket.
david: Thanks — will update INC-2026-77 with applied changes and a cost breakdown.
alex: Awesome, thanks everyone. I'll loop in customer with the timeline and share the smoke test invite. :raised_hands:
